name: Tah Tong Textile Co., Ltd.
summary: Tah Tong Textile Co., Ltd., based in Taiwan, specializes in manufacturing and distributing a diverse range of textile products. Its offerings include cotton yarn, finished fabrics, T/C blended yarns, synthetic fiber yarns, and environmentally friendly (green) fabrics. The company also produces knitted fabrics and various related items. Founded in 1958, its corporate headquarters are located in Taipei, Taiwan.
